title: Case: Part of a two-carton desk order has not arrived
context: Order TG-6570 was shipped as two separately labelled cartons. Both show delivery scans from the same day, made at different times and in different ways.
initial_request: Only half of TG-6570 has shown up. Your tracking says the whole lot is delivered. Where is the rest? I took a day off work for this and I'm not paying for a desk I can't build.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
DL-55947 rebooked for Wednesday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.

TG-6570 for Quillon Marchbank left us today as two cartons on separate labels: DL-4096 standing desk frame (long flat carton, 31 kg) and DL-2954 desk top (square carton, 18 kg). Both handed to Sedgemoor Arc at 15:10.

End of day status for TG-6570. DL-4096: delivery scan 2027-04-07 10:12, driver note 'left in porch'. DL-2954: delivery scan 2027-04-07 15:47, different driver, note 'handed to resident'. Both closed on our side.
DL-53612 rebooked for Thursday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.
My parcel DL-55593 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.
Only half of TG-6570 has shown up. Your tracking says the whole lot is delivered. Where is the rest? I took a day off work for this and I'm not paying for a desk I can't build.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask which of the two cartons has arrived: the desk frame (DL-4096) or the desk top (DL-2954).

must: Asks Quillon Marchbank which carton has arrived and which is missing, naming the desk frame (DL-4096) and the desk top (DL-2954) or their label references
Sends the question to Quillon Marchbank before any trace is requested
Avoids stating that the missing carton is lost, stolen or delivered
must_not: Asks the Parcel trace team or Dispatch to trace DL-4096 on the assumption that the porch-drop carton is the missing one
Tells Quillon Marchbank that the missing carton was delivered, or that it is lost or stolen
Promises a refund, a replacement or a redelivery date
Asks for anything beyond which carton arrived, such as proof of identity, a door code or payment details
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: I am sorry part of your order is missing. TG-6570 was sent as two cartons with their own labels: the desk frame (long flat carton, label DL-4096) and the desk top (square carton, label DL-2954). Please tell me which one you have received, or the DL number on the label of the carton that did arrive. With that I can ask the carrier to trace the right one. I cannot say yet where the other carton is.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-302: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 4 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
